Name: Eunoia's Aquarium - Blobfish and Psychrolutes
Author: eunoiamods
Description:
[size=5][b]Eunoia's Aquarium - Blobfish and Psychrolutes
[/b][/size]
Retextures and recolours the blobfish and optionally returns it to a healthly Psychrolutes.

Did you know that Blobfish don't usually look... like that? They're usually very cute! Unfortunately, fishing them up very quickly causes them to rapidly decompress and become deformed and sad.

We wouldn't do that to a poor fish would we? No! In Stardew Valley, we go down to the deep sea to fish for them, so they should come up happy and whole. Whether they stay that way... that's up to you!

While Blobfish is the legitimate name for this type of fish, it's quite misleading when it isn't so blobby, so some refer to their scientific name, Psychrolutes, when talking about them in their natural habitat.
[size=4][b]
Features[/b][/size]

- Several colour options for psychrolutes!

- Optional name and description change!

- Separate options for the aquarium, hat and inventory!

[size=4][b]Future Plans
[/b][/size]
Did I miss a blobfish related item?
Do you want a different colour to what I've offered here?
Any other suggestion I haven't thought of?

Let me know!

[size=4][b]Troubleshooting[/b][/size]

When the mod is added to an existing save, the changes may fail to load properly. This can be fixed by changing the config to a different option and back again. Any other problems, let me know![size=4][b]
